actions.text: Pressing "Test All Indexers" runs a test of all indexers.
Pressing "Manage Indexers" opens the Manage Indexers dialog.
The toolbar save button saves the pending changes of the Options section.
Pressing the Add Indexer card opens the Add Indexer dialog; selecting an indexer type or preset closes it and opens the edit dialog.
Pressing a card opens the edit dialog; its clone action opens the edit dialog prefilled from that indexer.
The edit dialog offers Test, Cancel and Save, plus Delete when editing an existing indexer; Delete asks for confirmation then deletes the indexer.
In Manage Indexers, selected indexers can be bulk deleted (after confirmation), bulk edited, or have tags applied; the table can be sorted by column.

rules.text: Delete, Edit and Set Tags in Manage Indexers are disabled until at least one indexer is selected.

Bulk edit only sends fields changed from "no change" (Rss, Automatic Search, Interactive Search, priority, max single episode age); nothing is sent if none changed. Priority is 1-50 and max age is at least 0 days.
Tags can be applied to selected indexers with mode add (default), remove or replace.
In the edit dialog, indexer priority is 1-50, and Rss/search checkboxes are disabled when the indexer does not support them.
Cloning copies the indexer with name from the copied-profile default and clears apiKey and password field values.
A new indexer from a schema defaults its name to the implementation name, with RSS enabled if supported and automatic and interactive search enabled if search is supported.
Test-all results can come from a 400 error response body array; otherwise the error is treated as a failure.
Saving an existing indexer with no changes skips testing and validation; re-saving identical data skips testing; after a warnings-only result the next save skips warning validation.
The edit dialog closes automatically after a save finishes without error.

shows.text: The page is titled "Indexer Settings" and shows an "Indexers" heading with a section description, followed by the indexer cards and an Options section.
Toolbar buttons "Test All Indexers" (spinning while testing) and "Manage Indexers" are shown.
A status line shows "Testing all indexers" while testing, a completed message when results exist, or a failed message (as an alert) when the test call fails without per-indexer results.
Indexers are listed as cards sorted by name ascending, followed by an "Add Indexer" card. A load error message is shown if loading fails.
Each indexer card shows its name, Enabled/Disabled status, priority (only when any indexer's priority is not 25), and test status after a test-all run.
Each card shows a protocol label, Rss, Automatic Search and Interactive Search labels (only when supported and enabled), and a tag list when the indexer has tags.
The test status of a card is Not tested, Failed (any non-warning failure), Warning (only warnings) or Passed.
The Options section shows Minimum Age (minutes), Retention (days) and Maximum Size (MB) number inputs, plus an advanced RSS Sync Interval (minutes, 0-120) input.
The Options section shows a loading indicator while fetching and an error alert if loading options fails.

The Add Indexer dialog lists available indexer types grouped under Usenet and Torrents, with a loading indicator and an error alert on failure. Items with presets have a Presets menu and a More Info link.

The Manage Indexers dialog shows a table of indexers with selection checkboxes, name, protocol, implementation, Rss/Automatic Search/Interactive Search Yes/No labels, priority, max single episode age and tags. It shows "No indexers found" when empty.

sideEffects.text: Test All sends a POST to the indexer testall endpoint.
Bulk edit sends a PUT to the indexer bulk endpoint and updates cached indexers with the result.
Bulk delete sends a DELETE to the indexer bulk endpoint and removes the deleted indexers from the cached list.
Deleting a single indexer sends a DELETE for that indexer and removes it from the cached list.
Saving Options sends a PUT of the settings and refreshes the cached settings, clearing pending changes.
